تحتسبي (form VIII)
# تَحْتَسِبِي (taḥtasibī) /taħ.ta.si.biː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَسَبَ (iḥtasaba)
# تُحْتَسَبِي (tuḥtasabī) /tuħ.ta.sa.biː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَسَبَ (iḥtasaba)
